releases.name: Abandoned Hearts
releases.summary: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

releases.name: Laid-Back Camp All -in -one!! Chill Time
releases.summary: Dê ao Seu Bebê uma dianteira aprendendo números, cores, e cantando junto.? Ensina Música? Ensina Cores? Ensina Números? Diversas canções de CriançasModo Bilíngue também ensina? Ensina Espanhol? Ensina Espanhol? Ensina Chinês? Ensina Francês? Ensina Hindu? Ensina Alemão? Ensina Japonês? Ensina Russo

releases.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
releases.summary: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

releases.name: Hurl (Kiss A Fish)
releases.summary: HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena. The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

releases.name: CUSTOM PENNANT BASEBALL
releases.summary: A baseball front office sim you can rebuild. Swap in your own club logos and player portraits, rewrite names, cities and colours, and change every rule value: club count, DH, games per season, even the ball. You never control a player. Japanese interface only.

releases.name: Fungal Field
releases.summary: Start with a seed. Change more than the landscape. Fungal Field is an ecological sandbox where colonies grow, wildlife forages, and fungal infection can turn deer and humans into zombies. Nurture the soil. Shape the conditions. Discover what grows from here.

releases.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
releases.summary: Samurai Hero vs Evil Army! Jump off different rocks and objects as you fight your way across the acient lands. Slash your way to freedom from enemy samurai. You'll grab coins that can really add up, and you can take adventage of fantastic game-pay and stunning sounds and graphics. Each detail is professionally detailed and you'll be ADDICTED! Download Samurai Hero Kingdom now!

releases.name: ARCS
releases.summary: ** One Word --- A D D I C T I N G !!!! **** Gorgeous 3D Rendered Graphics! **** FastPaced, CraZy Action! **Apocalypse Run is like a classic running game mixed with 10000 cans of Red Bull.  You're trying to run for your life, while avoiding falling debris of an asteroid, burning cars, shooting flames, and more! Do you have the skills needed to survive the day?FEATURES- Gorgeous 3D rendered graphics.- Lots of challenging obstacles to avoid.- Original soundtrack.

releases.name: Fish Wrangler
releases.summary: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

releases.name: L Wars: Chi Town
releases.summary: Ride Chicago's L, work the platforms, and build a street empire in a tense, turn-based strategy simulation. Buy low, sell high, manage heat and debt, and decide how far you'll push your luck before time runs out.

releases.name: Halloween On Goober Street
releases.summary: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

releases.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
releases.summary: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king’s ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

releases.name: Chained Pirates Together
releases.summary: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

releases.name: SpacePorts
releases.summary: Build your fleet, master the market, and carve your own path among the stars. Start with a modest ship, earn credits by transporting valuable cargo between stations, and expand your operations into a powerful interstellar empire.

releases.name: Sudoku Unlimited
releases.summary: Play Sudoku solo or solve one board together in two-player online co-op with a room code. Explore seven variants in solo play, enjoy fresh Classic puzzles, or take the optional guided path. Pencil notes, undo and relaxing music give you room to think.
